about: Which delivery tags each voice model says well, by ear. One place, read by the machine (machine/models.py, voice_tags) and the page (voice-tags.ts).
A voice keeps, and the prompt offers, the tags its tokenizer knows that are under `say` here. Every other tag is stripped before synthesis; `not` says why, in a word.
A voice with no entry keeps every tag its tokenizer knows, and says so in the log: a new voice tries the whole range and is pruned by ear. No entry inherits another's.
A new entry: render each tokenizer tag at the start of a sentence in a pill's clip, one WAV, and Eugene's ear decides. `as` points one voice at another's entry when they are the same model.
`say` notes: 'ear' is heard and kept by him; 'on trial' is offered until he has listened (none today).
